description:
The terminal panel keeps the terminal inside its padded content area. The test seeded a conversation at /c/term-layout. window.__terminalSizeMessages lists the init and resize messages ({type, cols, rows}) the page's terminals sent their server, in order. "The terminal" is '.terminal-panel-content [data-terminal-id][style*="display: block"]'; terminals render with ghostty by default, which paints a canvas (the inside check takes either renderer's screen). The viewport starts at 1280x720.
"The inside check" is this eval, which must become exactly {"screenBottom":true,"screenRight":true,"terminalBottom":true,"terminalRight":true} (xterm adds its screen after the container shows, so poll until then): (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.terminal-panel-content [data-terminal-id][style*="display: block"]'); const t = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const c = el.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect(); const screen = el.querySelector(".xterm-screen, canvas"); if (!screen) return null; const s = screen.getBoundingClientRect(); return {terminalBottom: t.bottom <= c.bottom, terminalRight: t.right <= c.right, screenBottom: s.bottom <= t.bottom, screenRight: s.right <= t.right}; })()
1. Navigate to /c/term-layout and open the Terminal workspace tool: click the visible button named exactly "Terminal" (aria-label or text) in ".chat-workspace-actions"; only if there is none, use the overflow menu as phones do (the visible button with aria-label exactly "More options", then the button in ".chat-overflow-popover" whose text starts with "Terminal").
2. The terminal should become visible (wait up to 30s).
3. Run the inside check.
4. The cols of the first "init" message in window.__terminalSizeMessages should become greater than 0. Record them in a window variable as the initial cols.
5. Click the button with aria-label exactly "Minimize terminals". The terminal should be hidden (minimizing sets display: none on ".terminal-panel-content").
6. Set the viewport to 900x720. Eval: wait two animation frames (a promise resolved by requestAnimationFrame inside requestAnimationFrame). Then eval: empty window.__terminalSizeMessages (set its length to 0).
7. Click the button with aria-label exactly "Expand terminals". The terminal should be visible.
8. Run the inside check again.
9. The narrower window must shrink the terminal: (the cols of the last "resize" message in window.__terminalSizeMessages, or the initial cols if there is none) should become less than the initial cols.
